structural_reduction.extra_profile: J_x = induced adjacency on Z_x plus incidence from Z_x to F_Omega minus {x}, modulo rooted weighted-G0 automorphisms
structural_reduction.successor_rule: old frontier survives; old weight increments exactly on G0-neighbors of x; every z in Z_x enters with weight 1; all old-old edges are G0 minus x; the only missing successor edges are exactly J_x
structural_reduction.scope: one-step only; FCC and HCP; one current unoccupied component Omega

exact_root_star_pressure.note: The all-12 occupied root cage is excluded because the root is then a shielded singleton unoccupied component. WL is used only for candidate bucketing; all matched-current and successor comparisons are exact VF2++ weighted graph isomorphism tests. This bounded classification is regression/evidence, not a global rigidity proof.
